description: This file implements a cooldown cache mechanism for managing model deployment cooldown periods in a system, including adding cooldowns, retrieving active cooldowns, and calculating minimum cooldown times. It involves cache interactions and exception masking.

classes.name: CooldownCache
classes.description: Manages cooldown periods for model deployments, including adding, retrieving, and calculating cooldowns, with support for in-memory and external cache layers.

classes.name: CooldownCacheValue
classes.description: TypedDict representing the values stored in cooldown cache, including exception info, status code, timestamp, and cooldown duration.

methods.name: Tuple[str,CooldownCacheValue] _common_add_cooldown_logic( self, model_id: str, original_exception, exception_status, cooldown_time: float )
methods.description: Prepares and returns cache key-value pair with cooldown data, including exception masking.

methods.name: add_deployment_to_cooldown( self, model_id: str, original_exception: Exception, exception_status: int, cooldown_time: Optional[float], )
methods.description: Adds a deployment's cooldown info to cache, with TTL based on cooldown duration.

methods.name: str get_cooldown_cache_key(model_id: str)
methods.description: Generates a unique cache key for a deployment cooldown based on model ID.

methods.name: List[Tuple[str,CooldownCacheValue]] async_get_active_cooldowns( self, model_ids: List[str], parent_otel_span: Optional[Span] )
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves active cooldowns for a list of model IDs, utilizing cache and in-memory checks.

methods.name: List[Tuple[str,CooldownCacheValue]] get_active_cooldowns( self, model_ids: List[str], parent_otel_span: Optional[Span] )
methods.description: Synchronously retrieves active cooldowns for a list of model IDs from cache.

methods.name: float get_min_cooldown( self, model_ids: List[str], parent_otel_span: Optional[Span] )
methods.description: Calculates the minimum cooldown time among a group of model IDs.
